search.description: searching the literature for papers on a topic, building PICO questions or search strategies
search.label: search PubMed for papers on a topic

article_details.description: looking up details, abstract, metadata or citation metrics of specific known articles by PMID or DOI, or verifying a reference list
article_details.label: abstract, authors, metrics of a given PMID

citation_network.description: finding related articles, who cites an article, an article's references, or building a citation tree
citation_network.label: papers citing or related to an article

fulltext.description: getting the full text, PDF, text-mined entities or figures of an article
fulltext.label: full text, figures, text mining of an article

export.description: exporting citations to a reference manager format (RIS, BibTeX, EndNote) or saving literature notes
export.label: export citations to BibTeX, RIS; save notes

gene.description: looking up a gene, its details, or the literature about a gene
gene.label: look up a gene

compound.description: looking up a chemical compound or drug in PubChem, its details, or literature about it
compound.label: look up a chemical compound or drug

variant.description: looking up a genetic variant and its clinical significance in ClinVar
variant.label: genetic variant clinical significance

chronicle.description: building, reading or comparing a research chronicle (the evolving history of a research question)
chronicle.label: research chronicle of a topic over time

images.description: searching biomedical images or analysing a figure or image to find literature
images.label: biomedical images, figure-based search

institutional.description: configuring, testing or diagnosing institutional library access (link resolver, OpenURL) to get paywalled full text
institutional.label: library access to full text via resolver

icd.description: converting between ICD diagnosis codes and MeSH terms
icd.label: convert ICD codes and MeSH terms

pipeline.description: saving, loading, listing, deleting or scheduling a reusable saved search pipeline, or viewing its run history
pipeline.label: PubMed search pipelines: save, list, schedule

session.description: reading the PMIDs, cached articles or summary of the current search session
session.label: PMIDs in the current session

zotero_library.description: searching or browsing the items in my own Zotero library, tags, item types, statistics
zotero_library.label: search or browse items in my Zotero library

zotero_collections.description: my Zotero collections (folders): list, find, tree, contents
zotero_collections.label: my Zotero collections and their contents

zotero_save.description: saving or importing papers into my Zotero library
zotero_save.label: save or import papers into Zotero

zotero_saved_search.description: saved searches stored in Zotero: list, details, run
zotero_saved_search.label: saved searches in Zotero

zotero_status.description: checking whether Zotero is running and reachable
zotero_status.label: check the Zotero connection
